package.name: star_simple_bridge
package.description:
Minimal ASCII-line serial bridge between ROS2 and the RX72N motor controller over /dev/ttyACM0. Intended as a SLAM MVP replacement for the full star_gateway_bridge while the wire protocol is stabilized on the firmware side.
Subscribes to /cmd_vel (geometry_msgs/Twist) and emits "V fl fr bl br\n" per-wheel velocity commands. Parses "E fl fr bl br ms\n" encoder frames from the firmware and publishes integrated skid-steer odometry on /odom/unfiltered for the robot_localization EKF to consume.
